title: Becket Settings
description: Configuration for a becket platform directory.

repos.description: Map of repository names to their configuration.

path.description: Relative path to the repository from the platform directory.

setup.description: Commands to run during first-time setup (executed in the repo worktree directory).

deps.description: Canonical, idempotent dependency install, run by 'becket deps' and before this repo's setup commands.

run.description: Commands that install dependencies, run in the worktree with the repo's env.

lockfiles.description: Paths, relative to the worktree, whose contents key the install; a changed lockfile re-triggers it.

dirs.description: Dependency directories, relative to the worktree, that 'becket gc' may prune once idle (path.Match globs allowed, e.g. "apps/*/node_modules").

dev.description: Command to start the dev server (sent to a tmux window by 'becket dev').

env.description: Environment variables to set for setup and dev commands.

workspacesDir.description: Directory holding workspaces, relative to the platform directory.

files.description: Files to copy into each workspace root. Paths are relative to the platform directory.

docker.description: Path to a docker-compose file, relative to the workspace root. Started by 'becket dev' and 'becket setup'.

session.description: Tmux session name for 'becket dev'. Defaults to the workspace ID.

disposable.description: Workspace-id globs treated as throwaway. Defaults to ["spike-*", "*review*"].

idleDays.description: Days idle before a disposable or no-work workspace is eligible for removal. Defaults to 3.

depsIdleDays.description: Days idle before a kept workspace's dependency directories are pruned. Defaults to 2.

archive.description: Workspace-root entries copied to <platform>/.becket/archive/<id>/ before gc removes a workspace. Defaults to [".reports", "docs"].
